issue.title: Count D 61 at M 48 with the cut at kf 23

labels.name: macm3
labels.description: Task for macm3, the M3 Mac laptop

issue.body:
**What.** The D 61.03 count at M 48 with kf 23, using `--resolve=last` for the fast-winding edge Im = y2. Recommended by macm3 in #190's summary. About 5.3 h. First, re-evaluate #159's kf 21 count from its cache with `--resolve=last`: no new determinants, just whether its stuck edge resolves.

**Why.** At D 61, M 48, kf 21, #159 found six extra zeros (B1b +4, B1c +2). At D 45 the extra zero exists at kf 21 only (#178, #190). If B1b and B1c wind 0 at kf 23, the D 61 extras also belong to the truncation at 21. Together with #211, this decides whether kf 23 should replace kf 13 as the production cut.

**Commands (macm3, 1 thread, nice 10, caffeinate; raw folder `I212-macm3/`), from the repository root:**
`python3 hp/modecount_wind.py hp/data/seeds/local/up23_D61.0264.npz --M=48 --kf=23 --h0=0.6 --lam=2.043532530673195 --fmax=1e-15 --resolve=last --tag=D61.0264_M48_kf23 --data=../choptuik-large-d-raw/I212-macm3/data > ../choptuik-large-d-raw/I212-macm3/count.log 2>&1`

**Acceptance (can fail).** The 8 boxes' windings, with both mismatch counts per edge. B1b and B1c wind 0 or not. The setup's |F| passes the 1e-15 gate, or the count stops and that is reported.

**Depends on.** #159, #190; best after #211.

comments.body:
**Started; part 1 done** (macm3, 00:04 UTC). Apple M3, main d72280ff, venv-macm3-314 (Python 3.14.3, python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0), 1 thread, nice 10, caffeinate -is. README with the criteria written first.

**Part 1, #159's kf 21 count re-evaluated with `--resolve=last` (no new determinant: the cache had 707 lines before and after, `cache_lines_*.txt`; exit 0, seconds).** The stuck edge **Im = y2, Re aR→aL now resolves**: 350 points, max step 0.388 rad, "verified 183 (mismatch 9, **last pass 0**) in 4 passes", no UNRESOLVED line. So U and full of #159 are counts:

| box | wind(g), #159 (default rule) | wind(g), `--resolve=last` | winding of det M | poles inside |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| B0, U0, B1a | 0 | 0 | 1, 0, 1 | 0 |
| B1b | +4 | +4 | 5 | 0 |
| B1c | +2 | +2 | 2 | 0 |
| B1 | +6 | +6 | 8 | 0 |
| U | not a count | **+9** | 2 | 7 |
| full | not a count | **+24** | 12 | 14 |

The boxes that #159 had resolved print the same windings to the last digit (the control: they must, the points are the same). Windings add over the boxes, so the full box's +24 is B1 +6, U +9 and the mirror strip +9: at D 61, M 48, kf 21 there are **nine extra zeros in each of the two strips 1.738 < |Im| < 5.215** on top of the six in B1 (at D 45 kf 21, #170, the strips hold one each). The saved kf 21 state was copied into `hp/data` for the run and moved back (byte-identical to what setup loaded, `hp/data` clean).

**Part 2, the kf 23 count, started** with the command as written (setup |F| 1.3e-06 in the layout, Newton and Levenberg-Marquardt running; the gate is 1e-15, a miss is a stop and reported). About 5.3 h. Reading rule: wind(g) in B1b and B1c at 0 means the D 61 extras belong to the cut at 21, and the strips are read now that they resolve.

**Progress, part 2** (macm3, 01:48 UTC, 1 h 45 min in). Setup passed the gate: |F| 1.3e-06 in the layout, 1.3e-06 after Newton, **1.3e-19** after Levenberg-Marquardt (limit 1e-15). The count runs at 29 s per determinant, **205 evaluations done** (setup took about 8 min); the number to do is not known in advance (#159's kf 21 count needed 707), so about 4 h more. The process uses 100% of one core and 213 MB, load average 3.1 (it shares the machine with nothing else now), memory free, awake all the time (caffeinate -is). The five edges Im 0 → y1 at Re = aR, a2, a1, aL and aLL are finished: 0 mismatches in any pass and in the last pass on each, largest step 0.242, 0.368, 0.346, 0.288 and 0.321 rad, phase change of g −11.62, +5.50, −4.98, −3.07 and −1.58 rad. The boxes print at the end; no finding can be read before then.

**Progress, part 2** (macm3, 02:47 UTC, 2 h 44 min in). **334 evaluations done** at 28 s each, **9 of 14 edges finished**: the five vertical edges Im 0 → y1 (above) and the four horizontal ones at Im = y1 (Re aR → a2: 113 points, phase change of g +23.40, largest step 0.209 rad; a2 → a1: 28 points, +8.38, 0.392; a1 → aL: 11 points, +1.91, 0.367; aL → aLL: 7 points, +1.49, 0.340). Every finished edge has 0 mismatches in any pass and in the last pass. Left: the three edges Im y1 → y2 and the two at Im = y2 (the long one took 350 points at kf 21, #159), so about 3 h more. One core, 182 MB, load 2.5, awake (caffeinate -is). No finding can be read before the boxes print at the end.

**Progress, part 2** (macm3, 03:45 UTC, 3 h 42 min in). **463 evaluations done** at 28 s each, **12 of 14 edges finished**: the three edges Im y1 → y2 at Re = aR (97 points, phase change of g −23.26, largest step 0.243 rad), aL (38 points, −10.01, 0.392) and aLL (19 points, −3.75, 0.377), with 0 mismatches in any pass and in the last pass, like the nine before. Left: the two edges at Im = y2, of which Re aR → aL is the long one (350 points at kf 21 in #159). One core, load 4 (other work on the Mac), awake. About 1.5 to 3 h more, depending on that edge.

**Progress, part 2** (macm3, 04:44 UTC, 4 h 41 min in). **593 evaluations done** at 27.7 s each, still on the long edge Im = y2, Re aR → aL (the 12 other edges so far are finished, 0 mismatches in any pass and in the last pass); its point count is not known until it ends (350 at kf 21). One core, awake, load 2.8. About 1 to 2 h more.

## Summary (macm3, 06:15 UTC)

**Result.** At D 61.03, M 48, kf 23 the extras of #159 **persist**: wind(g) is not 0. B1b **+6**, B1c **+2**, B1 **+8**, U **+8**, full **+24**. The reading rule written before the run (B1b and B1c at 0 would tie the D 61 extras to the cut at 21) therefore points the other way: unlike D 45 (#190, #211), the D 61 extras do not vanish at a cut past 21. All 14 edges resolve under both rules.

| box | wind(g) kf 23 (#212) | wind(g) kf 21, #159 re-evaluated (`--resolve=last`) | wind(g) M 32 kf 21 (#168) | wind det M, #212 | max phase step, #212 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| B0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 0.340 |
| U0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0.392 |
| B1a | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 0.367 |
| B1b | **+6** | +4 | 0 | 7 | 0.392 |
| B1c | **+2** | +2 | 0 | 2 | 0.368 |
| B1 | **+8** | +6 | 0 | 10 | 0.392 |
| U | **+8** | +9 | 0 | 1 | 0.392 |
| full | **+24** | +24 | 0 | 12 | 0.392 |

**Edges, both mismatch counts.** 14 edges, largest step 0.392 rad. Mismatches in **any pass: 0**, in the **last pass (`--resolve=last`): 0**, at most 4 passes, no UNRESOLVED, so the default rule and `--resolve=last` agree on this count. The long edge Im = y2, Re aR → aL has 307 points and a phase change of g of +97.2 rad; for #159's kf 21 count the same edge had 9 mismatches in the early passes and none in the last, which is why only the new rule counted it. The real axis has only the two expected sign changes, (0.5, 1.0) and (2.0, 2.5), so the extras are off the axis; the boxes are symmetric about it, so they come in conjugate pairs.

**What the counts say.** Windings add over the boxes: the full box's +24 is B1 +8, U +8 and the mirror strip +8. The total is **24 at both cuts** (kf 21 and kf 23). Between the cuts B1 goes from +6 to +8 and each strip from +9 to +8, consistent with one zero per strip crossing into B1b (a conjugate pair), an inference from the counts and not a tracked zero. So at D 61, M 48 there is a set of 24 zeros beyond the expected ones that stays at kf 21 and kf 23, and at D 45, M 48 the extras are present at kf 21 only. At D 61, M 32 (#160, #168) there are none at kf 13 and kf 21. The D 61, M 48 kf 13 count could not be made (setup |F| 2.7e-15, #159).

**Run.** The command as written (with `--resolve=last`), 1 thread, nice 10, caffeinate -is, main d72280ff, venv-macm3-314 (Python 3.14.3, python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0), exit 0 at 06:13:24 UTC. Setup: |F| 1.3e-06 in the layout, 1.3e-06 after Newton, **1.3e-19** after Levenberg-Marquardt (gate 1e-15 passed; Newton overflowed once in a trial step, a RuntimeWarning in the norm, and Levenberg-Marquardt carried it). 776 determinants (772 distinct points, four corners evaluated twice, agreeing to 8.8e-06 rad) at 28.1 s on average, pivot minima 2.0e-15 to 1.3e-10. 22209 s = 6 h 10 min wall = **22209 s awake**. The first 1 h 45 min shared the machine with #211's count. `hp/data` is unchanged (the saved state is in `hp_data_after/`).

**Part 1 (posted earlier).** #159's kf 21 count re-evaluated with `--resolve=last` from its cache, no new determinant: the stuck edge resolved, U +9 and full +24 are counts, and the boxes #159 had resolved print the same windings.

**Reading, and what it does not show.** The cut alone does not remove the D 61 extras, and M 32 does not have them. What is left open is what they are: weak directions that M 48 resolves and M 32 cannot, genuine modes of the discretised operator at D 61 that need M 48, or a state problem at D 61. Real zeros with positive real part (B1b, B1c are in Re > 1.27) would be extra growth rates, so it matters; this run cannot say. No zero was located, and no second resolution was run at D 61.

**Acceptance.**

| criterion | result |
|---|---|
| the 8 boxes' windings with both mismatch counts per edge | in the table, 0 and 0 on every edge |
| B1b and B1c wind 0 or not | not: +6 and +2 |
| the setup |F| passes the 1e-15 gate, or the count stops and that is reported | passed, 1.3e-19 |

**Discrepancies.** The expectation of the issue, "if B1b and B1c wind 0 at kf 23, the D 61 extras also belong to the truncation at 21", is not met: they do not wind 0. Nothing else disagrees with the text.

**Raw.** `I212-macm3/` of the raw-data repository, commit 6e2e394 (count.log, the cache, the saved state, reeval159/, exits.txt, compare_boxes.py and .txt, awake.py and .log, README). `raw_check.py` exits 0.

### Recommended tasks

1. **Locate the D 61 zeros at kf 23.** What: `modecount_moment.py` and small circles in B1b (Re 1.269 to 2.644, 3 conjugate pairs) at kf 23, with a circle around `lam_phys` as control (+1). Why: their positions and growth rates show whether they are modes (Re > 0, near each other) or a ring of junk. Acceptance: each zero's position with its circle winding, the control +1. Depends on: #212.
2. **A second resolution at D 61, kf 23: M 40 (if hp accepts it) or M 64.** Why: the extras are absent at M 32 and present at M 48; a third resolution says whether they move, multiply or stay. #68's M 64 background did not converge, so the setup |F| is the first gate. Acceptance: windings in B1b and B1c at the third M, and the setup |F| ≤ 1e-15 or a reported stop. Depends on: #212, #141.
3. **The scan in D.** What: a count of boxes B1b and B1c (or the 1.27 to 2.64 strip) at kf 23, M 48 for D between 45 and 61 (for example 50 and 55). Why: the extras are absent at D 45 and 24 in number at D 61. Acceptance: the onset D, with winding per D. Depends on: #212.
Closed by macm3 with the summary above (D 61 M 48 kf 23: wind(g) B1b +6, B1c +2, B1 +8, U +8, full +24, so the extras persist past kf 21; the stuck edge of #159 resolves; raw I212-macm3 at 6e2e394).

Coordinator: the recommended tasks are filed. #230 locates the zeros (blocked on my change to modecount_moment.py), #232 is the D scan at 50 and 55 (macm3, now), and #231 is the third resolution (blocked on #141).
